en-US.description: Cooperative gate for the shell commands AI coding agents run
en-US.longDescription: Command previews, automatic backups, allow/ask/deny policy, and audit logging for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). Denies destructive commands by default, shows blast radius before approval, and takes a backup before execution.
en-US.name: Termaxa
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- GHSA-rp8h-f4h4-w4j3 is published: its row in SECURITY.md, 117 days exposed by @devdoc83 in #161
- docs: README in Japanese by @rogervokma-stack in #162
- A heredoc body line the shell never runs is matched against deny rules only: cat > next.config.ts <<'EOF' ... EOF && npm run build asks on the build, not on a line of the file by @devdoc83 in #163
- termaxa demo runs on a project the gate can see; mkdir, ps, sleep and tee join the starter; the doctor test's init on the controlled PATH by @devdoc83 in #164
- v0.21.8: a line of a file is not a command, and the demo runs on a project the gate can see by @devdoc83 in #165
New Contributors
